Bandizip_PluginDesc: Bandizip integration plugin. Lets SwiftList fill in the destination path in Bandizip's extract dialog (e.g. from the Quick Navigation menu).
Plugin_Comp_Desc_BandizipExtractDialogAd: Detects Bandizip's "choose extract path" dialog by its control structure (not window title, since Bandizip is localized) and lets SwiftList fill in its destination path field.
